ratings_why.fun: One pile with three jobs (fight fuel, missiles, stat currency) plus board-versus-Burrow placement and End of Turn order gives a real puzzle every turn, though the low-tier makers are plain.
ratings_why.distinct: Token swarms are familiar, but an off-board reserve that is both fight HP and spendable currency, and that you protect by moving Kits onto the board, plays unlike any of today's tribes.

verdict_why: "Your front unit" needs a definition before the Banner and Front Lemming can be read; the rest is ready.

points.text: Brother Onward and The Front Lemming say "your front unit" without defining it: slot F1, or the first living front-row unit in reading order? Gaps never close, so the answer changes who carries the Banner.
Herding Council, Ferrywife, Matron and Nester all fire at End of Turn and the order decides the whole Crossing build; state the reading-order rule on the cards' side, not only in risks.
Tunic Weaver only raises Kit size; let it choose +2 Attack or +2 Health on Kit size, so Ole and Bristle builds want different Weavers.
The Tide wins rounds but surfaced Kits deal no hero damage; one late card that counts surfaced Kits that survive would give that line a finisher.
Identical Cousin copying Herald, Litter Keeper or Ferrywife is the tribe's best hidden combo; worth keeping exactly as broad as it is.

standouts.why: Ole makes every Kit a missile-or-body choice, feeds Cantor at Start of Combat, and hits harder if Snow Hall Guard sits earlier in reading order.
Identical Cousin turns a free token into triple progress or a second engine piece, in any tribe.
Brother Onward's growing Banner meets Onward Kits at the front and a Mire or Hunker catcher behind, a three-card combo the board shape makes real.

weakest.why: Tunic Weaver does one obvious job with no decision.
Yellowcoat Squeaker is a plain maker; fine as glue, nothing to discover.
Herding Council is a smaller Ferrywife doing the same job.

flags.note: With Herald, Litter Keeper and Matron the Burrow settles around 28, so Ferrywife spends about 14 a turn: +14/+14 to each real unit, double when golden.
With Old Mother Lemen every Kit has Onward, so the Banner grows +4/+4 per Kit in a large Burrow; finite, but big.
A deep Burrow of Onward Kits with Gerd's Bristle could stall low-Attack boards into ties.
"Your front unit" is undefined (F1 slot or first living front-row unit).
